description: Checkmyguest offers you this dazzling 700 m² hotel, perfect for 10 people. You will appreciate its indoor swimming pool, private garden and modern facilities. Ideally located near the main tourist sites and the metro, it is the perfect place to make the most of your stay at the gateway to the City of Light!The space⭐ Looking for comfortable accommodation in Neuilly-sur-Seine? Our 700m² private mansion, ideally located, welcomes you in an exceptional setting. Perfect for 10 people, it offers all the comfort you need.Neuilly-sur-Seine, an upmarket town with tree-lined avenues, offers a prestigious setting close to Paris, with cultural sites such as the Château and the Museum of Modern Art.This location allows you to explore Paris using easily accessible public transport. You will be able to reach the city's various emblematic sites: Parc Monceau, the Eiffel Tower, the Louvre Museum, the Sacré Coeur, the Champs-Elysées, the Arc de Triomphe, etc. When you arrive, let yourself be seduced by the bright living room, furnished with care, modernity and elegant furnishings.You will have at your disposal :✔️ Two lounges bathed in a welcoming atmosphere, with comfortable sofas, a beautiful fireplace and a large dining table, to enjoy moments of conviviality.✔️ A fully-equipped, functional kitchen opening onto the living room, with fridge, freezer, dishwasher, microwave, induction hob, kettle, oven, coffee machine, wine cellar and toaster. There is also a TV in the room. ✔️ Five spacious bedrooms, each with a double bed. One of the bedrooms has a bright, fully marbled en suite bathroom with electric mirror and both bath and shower, as well as a WC. Benefit from a TV in the room to entertain you in your bath.✔️ A large dressing room is accessible behind the bathroom for your personal
